text: You asked ChatGPT to be your fucking setter, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Bro, we're on air. Okay, ChatGPT or Claude, who's the better setter?
style: First a hushed, embarrassed whisper, then switching into a hyped podcast host voice, a casual American guy.

text: Round one, writing the reply. Both are great, it's a tie.
style: Calm and fair like a referee, a little bored, short beats.

text: See, AI does my DMs now.
style: Smug and proud, showing off to his buddy.

text: Round two, who reads the DM?

style: Casual and confident, like it's obvious.
Flat and deadpan, the trap closing.

text: Me again, I paste it back.
style: Slowing down mid-sentence, the confidence cracking as he realizes.

text: So the setter is you. You're a human clipboard with a podcast.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the last words.

text: Okay, so who wins, ChatGPT or Claude?
style: Annoyed and impatient, wanting a straight answer.

text: Whoever wins, you're still the setter.
style: Suddenly dead serious, low and slow, every word landing.

text: Everything around the model. Your offer, your voice, waiting till they're done typing, one question at a time, booking, follow-ups.
style: Fast, confident and rhythmic, like listing flexes, a tiny beat after the first sentence.

text: And you do all that, little bubble?
style: Mocking and teasing, laughing at him a little.

text: Little? My own setting model, years of setting work, right inside your ManyChat, so nobody pastes anything.
style: Offended on the first word, then smooth and proud, a sly emphasis on the last three words.

text: Okay, okay. How do I set you up?
style: Giving in, a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay okay.

text: Stop recording first, your listeners heard all that shit.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
